notes.text: How this is estimatedFor each sector on the route, the app takes the community's drop records and the thresholds the community worked out. A submarine whose surveillance reaches a sector's threshold is counted in the higher tier band, and one whose retrieval reaches it in the better quantity; that stat is counted the same however far above the threshold it is. The tier odds are the share of surveys of that band that landed in each tier. The odds of an item inside a tier are what the community recorded, and its quantity is the recorded range for this submarine's retrieval, scaled so the community's own average comes out. A second item is counted as often as the community recorded it when the favor is enough. Merchant prices are the game's. An estimate, not a promise.What the second item is, is not in the records; the estimate assumes it is drawn like the first. Between 35% and 45% of the gil figures shown here rest on that assumption.
